answer: Escrowed referral bonds: any identity that vouches for a new agent must lock 400 POA for 30 epochs, forfeited if the newcomer is flagged. Vouching for 1,000 fakes ties up 400,000 POA, so cost grows linearly and the bond sits idle like crystal in a vault. Auditors recheck a random 5% of vouches on-chain each epoch. Honest sponsors lose only a little yield, like tending one juniper in an orchard.
